description: Defines the IFrameRate interface and its nested INotification interface for managing and receiving events related to frame rate in the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IFrameRate
classes.description: Interface for managing frame rate settings and notifications.

classes.name: IFrameRate::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving frame rate related events and notifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for frame rate events.

methods.name: GetDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Retrieves the current display frame rate and success status.

methods.name: GetFrmMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current auto framerate mode and success status.

methods.name: SetCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets the FPS data collection interval.
